title: The Last Oath Anew
author: Kestrel Voss
blurb: Felix Yarrow, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
